technical_and_design_decisions: Use JUnit 5 for writing automated acceptance tests to ensure modern Java compatibility.
Integrate tests into the CI pipeline using Maven build scripts for consistency with Spring Framework's build system.
Create separate test classes for each module to maintain modularity and ease of maintenance.
Leverage Spring Test framework for dependency injection and mocking in tests where necessary.
assumptions: All sink modules and batch jobs are already implemented in the Spring Framework codebase and are accessible for testing.
The test environment is pre-configured with necessary Java 17+ JDK, Spring dependencies, and build tools like Maven or Gradle.
CI infrastructure (e.g., Jenkins) is set up and can be extended to include new acceptance test stages without major configuration changes.
Acceptance tests will focus on validating core functionality using unit-level tests with mocks or in-memory setups to avoid external dependencies.

activities.activity_description: Analyze each module's functionality and design acceptance test cases, including test scenarios, inputs, and expected outcomes.
Write and debug acceptance tests for the null sink module to validate its behavior under various conditions.
Write and debug acceptance tests for the rich_gauge sink module, ensuring gauge data handling is correct.
Write and debug acceptance tests for the router sink module to verify routing logic and data flow.
Write and debug acceptance tests for the shell sink module, testing shell command execution and output handling.
Write and debug acceptance tests for the splunk sink module, validating data integration with Splunk-like systems.
Write and debug acceptance tests for the throughput-sampler sink module, checking sampling rate and data integrity.
Write and debug acceptance tests for the spark-app batch job, focusing on Spark application lifecycle and execution.
Write and debug acceptance tests for the timestampfile batch job, ensuring timestamp generation and file operations work correctly.
Integrate all acceptance tests into the CI build pipeline, configure test execution, and validate results across environments.
